key_insight: A fully local, multi-agent AI system can deidentify multimodal hospital data with very high sensitivity while preserving clinically important information.
clinical_relevance: This could make safer reuse of sensitive clinical data for AI development and research without relying on cloud-based processing.
method: Integrated multimodal LLMs, task-specific neural networks, and rule-based transformations
Evaluated 16 orchestrator configurations on a benchmark combining synthetic and real multimodal hospital data
Tested deidentification and content preservation across text, images, audio, handwriting, and CT
evidence_signal: In the best local setup, per-patient deidentification sensitivity reached 98.80% overall and 100% on local data, with clinical preservation above 99.6% overall.
watch_item: Performance was benchmarked on specific datasets and configurations, so real-world deployment may require site-specific validation and careful monitoring for missed identifiers or over-redaction.
paper_title: The Multimodal Anonymizer: a fully local multi-agent AI system for medical data deidentification
